projects.title: Mixed Reality Horror Game
projects.category: FINAL YEAR PROJECT · UNITY · COMPUTER VISION
projects.description: A mixed-reality horror experience created with UTM Library, combining a TensorFlow image-recognition model, Pico eye tracking, blink interaction and a 3D recreation of the UTM Library.
projects.longDescription: An end-to-end mixed reality horror game designed to make UTM Library a part of the experience. Players interact through eye blinking while computer vision and a trained recognition model connect the physical and virtual environments.
projects.role: Developer — computer vision, machine learning integration, eye-tracking interaction and Unity environment development.
outcomes: Built a self-trained TensorFlow model for image recognition.
Implemented eye-blink interaction through Pico eye-tracking hardware.
Recreated the UTM Library in a 3D virtual environment.
